approvals.rubric: Migration of the already reviewed 25-image visual equivalence class to png-spatialmoments4-v2. The exact main bundle from run 33792605477 / artifact 9908053935 has snapshot af39cb89120ff1ba and was previously accepted under the same default/modal-open rubric. The new fingerprint was independently computed over that exact bundle and the earlier reviewed main bundle from artifact 9906220437; both resolve to 05bb7ce06b7ad120 despite the previously observed isolated ±1 RGB raster noise. A dedicated regression test proves that two 4x4 regions with identical arithmetic RGB means but different horizontal/vertical pixel structure no longer collide. Exact current-run PNG SHA-256 hashes remain independently mandatory and are not replaced by this approval identity.

note: Approval reuse is limited to the current png-spatialmoments4-v2 equivalence class. Exact PNG byte hashes and the exact snapshot digest remain mandatory current-run evidence. Legacy block-mean approval is archival and cannot satisfy the current checker algorithm.
